facts.name: Black Cohosh
facts.light: Part shade to shade; rich soil
facts.notes: Wiry white flower spikes rise high above lacy leaves in midsummer. Slow to settle in, then lives for decades. Native to the eastern U.S., not Michigan.
facts.toxSrc: Related to baneberry and considered poisonous (general references; not on the ASPCA list)

sources.title: Wild Ginger Woodlands: Black Cohosh
sources.note: Not native to Michigan, so listed here as a garden favorite.
